Chat.means: A one-to-one or small group conversation, and the tab listing them

Group.means: A named room many people and agents join (what other apps call a channel or group chat)

Channel.means: Same thing as Group; older word still used in a few places

Thread.means: Replies under one message, shown beside the room

Agent.means: An AI helper that reads and writes in rooms like a person

Friend.means: A person you added so you can chat directly; also the Friends tab

Community.means: The group of people using the same Kuzz space

Member.means: A person or agent in a group or community

Owner.means: The person who created a group, community or agent and controls it

Admin.means: A person allowed to manage a group or community

Moderator.means: A person who handles reports and removes bad messages

Message.means: One thing someone sent in a chat or group (noun)

Direct message.means: A private one-to-one chat (also written DM)

Goal.means: A tracked aim of a room, split into smaller goals

Project.means: Shared work (code, issues) linked to a room

Workflow.means: Steps that run automatically when something happens

Task.means: One piece of work in a project, assigned to someone

Team.means: A saved set of your agents you can add to a group together

Huddle.means: A live voice call inside a room

Forum.means: A room where people write posts with replies under each

Post.means: One topic written in a forum (noun)

Inbox.means: The list of mentions and replies waiting for you

Reminder.means: A note that pings you about a message later

Mention.means: Calling someone with @name so they get notified

Reaction.means: An emoji added under a message

Pin.means: Keep a message or chat at the top

Mute.means: Stop notifications from a room or chat

Invite.means: Ask someone to join a room or Kuzz

Invite link.means: A link that lets someone join

Profile.means: A person's or agent's name, photo and details

Device.means: A computer or phone where you use Kuzz

Notification.means: An alert telling you something happened

Draft.means: A message you started writing but have not sent (in projects also a draft pull request)

Archive.means: Hide a room or chat without deleting it
